στρατόν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
στόρεσαν: στόρνυμι — spread, strew; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they spread’

σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇς: σός — your, yours (sg.); fem. dat. pl., agreeing with νηυσί
σῖτον: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. acc. sg.

τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’

τέκετο: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέκετο): ’begot’, said of a father · also ’bore’, said of a mother
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι) · also indefinite τις, written τίς before the enclitic φησι: ’someone’ · also indefinite τίς with a noun, accented before an enclitic: ’some’ (κῆρύξ τίς … ’some herald’) · also indefinite τίς after εἰ, with ἄλλος: ’anyone (else)’ · also indefinite τίς + partitive gen.: ’some one (of the gods)’ (θεῶν τίς)

τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’

τοίχου: τοῖχος — wall (of a house or room); masc. gen. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart

τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl.: ’against whom’ (τοῖσιν κότον ἔθεσθε ’against whom you conceived resentment’) · also neut. dat. pl., of things: ’with these’

τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg.: ’this’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (αἰσχρὸν τόδε ἐστί)
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’

τύμβον: τύμβος — burial mound, grave-mound; masc. acc. sg.

τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)

τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’) · also fem. dat. sg. of possession, ’she has’ (τῇ … ἁπαλοὶ πόδες ’her feet are tender’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’) · also gen. pl., referring to the lands named: ’among these’ (τῶν σε … κεκάσθαι)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’) · also neut. dat. sg., object of πίσυνος: ’trusting in it’

χρυσῇ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., contracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.

ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.

ἀκούων: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’listening’

ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’) · also + gen., ’about, over’ (ἀμφ’ ὀλίγης πίδακος ’about a small spring’)

ἀνάγκη: ἀνάγκη — necessity, constraint; fem. nom. sg.

ἀνίστη: ἀνίστημι — raise, make stand up; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’raised’

ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid, you press’
ἄποινα: ἄποινα — ransom (a neuter plural noun); nom./acc. pl.

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle

ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’

ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.

ἐκέλευες: κελεύω — order, bid; impf. 2 sg. act.: ’you bade’
ἐκίδνατο: κίδναμαι — spread, spread abroad (poetic by-form of σκίδναμαι); impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’was spreading’
ἐκνοστήσαντι: ἐκνοστέω — come home safe from (+ gen.); aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’to one who has come home from’
ἐμοῖσιν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)

ἐοῦσα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic ἐοῦσα (= Attic οὖσα): ’being’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
ἐπένειμε: ἐπινέμω — deal out to, distribute (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’dealt out’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπικερτομέων: ἐπικερτομέω — taunt, mock; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐπικερτομῶν): ’mocking’
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρύσαντό: ἐρύω — draw, drag; pull off a spit; aor. 3 pl. mid., accented before enclitic τε
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (ἐς Πριάμοιο ’to Priam’s’)
ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’) · also + acc., ’over’ (ἐφ’ ὑγρὴν ’over the water’) · also preverb in tmesis, ἐφ’ … ἔχευε = ἐπέχευε ’poured upon’, + acc. as object (ἐφ’ ὕπνον ἔχευε ’poured sleep upon’)
ἐφύπερθε: ἐφύπερθε — over the top, above, on top of; adv.
ἐϋρρεῖος: ἐϋρρεής — fair-flowing; masc. gen. sg. (= Attic εὐρρεοῦς), agreeing with ποταμοῖο
ἐόντ: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. acc. dual, elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντε), epic (= Attic ὄντε): ’being’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐόντ’ = ἐόντα), agreeing with Πάτροκλον: ’being’
ἐῴκει: ἔοικα — be like, resemble; plpf. with impf. force, 3 sg.: ’resembled’
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’

ἑρμείας: Ἑρμείας — Hermes, epic form of Ἑρμῆς; masc. nom. sg.

ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτοῖμα: ἕτοιμος — ready, at hand; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ὀνείαθ’ · also neut. nom. pl., predicate with ταῦτα: ’ready’
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’ · also gnomic aor. 3 sg.: ’learns’ (ῥεχθὲν … ἔγνω ’learns when it is done’)
ἔδερόν: δέρω — flay, skin; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented (accent from the enclitic τε): ’they flayed’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔθ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided ἔθ’ before a rough breathing (ἔθ’ ὡς): ’still’
ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’drive’
ἔλλαβε: λαμβάνω — take, seize, get; aor. 3 sg., augmented with double λ, epic (= Attic ἔλαβε)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτά: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv., accented ἔπειτά before an enclitic (τοι) · also accented before the enclitic σε (ἔπειτά σε ’then … you’)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); masc. acc. sg., object of ἕντο with ἐξ: ’put away desire’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχουσαι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’holding’

ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.

ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠΰκομος: ἠΰκομος — fine-haired, epithet of goddesses and women; fem. nom. sg.
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. (= Attic ἕῳ): ’at dawn’
ἠὼς: Ἠώς — Dawn, the goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also ἠώς — morning, dawn (the time of day, not the goddess); fem. nom. sg.: ’it was morning’ (ἠὼς ἦν)
ἡμιόνους: ἡμίονος — mule; masc. acc. pl.; accent from the enclitic τε
ἡμιόνων: ἡμίονος — mule; gen. pl., construed as fem. with ἀγροτεράων · also gen. pl., after ἔκδεον: ’(bound) to the mules’

ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula

ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)

ἰόντες: εἶμι — go, come; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’going, coming’
ἱεροὺς: ἱερός — holy, sacred; masc. acc. pl.

ἴαλλον: ἰάλλω — send forth, put out (the hand); impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they put out’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’see!’ (ἴδε ἔργον ’see the deed’)
ἴδοιτο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in a conditional clause: ’should see’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., in an indirect question after a verb of looking: ’he might see’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴσαν: εἶμι — go, come; impf. 3 pl., epic: ’went’ · also οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 pl., epic ἴσαν (= Attic ᾔδεσαν): ’knew’
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀνείαθ: ὄνειαρ — good thing, benefit; of food, neut. acc. pl., elided (ὀνείαθ’ = ὀνείατα)
ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)

ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄλοντο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be destroyed; aor. 3 pl. mid., no augment
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄπτησάν: ὀπτάω — roast; aor. 3 pl. act., the unaugmented form of ὤπτησαν, accented before the enclitic τε: ’roasted’
ὄρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ὄρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὄψεαι: ὁράω — see; fut. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὄψει)
ὄϊν: ὄϊς — sheep, ewe; masc./fem. acc. sg. (ὄϊν, with diaeresis)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)

ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also ὡς ὅτε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’) · also + a φιν-form: ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφιν ’under the chariots’)
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’) · also + gen., of entreaty: ’by’ (λίσσομ’ ὑπὲρ ψυχῆς ’I beseech by your life’) · also + gen. of place: ’beyond, across’ (ὑπὲρ ποταμοῖο ’across the river’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’) · also postpositive + acc.: ’beneath’ (ἄντυγ’ ὕπο πρώτην ’under the outer rim’) · also adv. in tmesis after its verb, with an acc.: ’escaping’ (φυγὼν ὕπο νηλεὲς ἦμαρ = ὑποφυγών, ’escaping the pitiless day’) · also postpositive + gen. of cause: ’because of’ (ἀνδροκτασίης ὕπο ’because of a slaying’)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed, lost’
ὧδέ: ὧδε — in this way, thus; adv., accented ὧδέ before the enclitic σφ’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέζων: ῥέζω — do, act; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’doing’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
